scripts.prepackage: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'); const mv=require('./manifest.json').version; const pv=require('./package.json').version; if(mv!==pv){console.error('\x1b[31mERROR: Version mismatch! manifest.json ('+mv+') !== package.json ('+pv+'). Run: npm run set-version <ver>\x1b[0m'); process.exit(1);} const tags=execSync('git tag').toString().trim().split('\n'); if(tags.includes('v'+mv)){console.error('\x1b[31mERROR: v'+mv+' is already tagged. Bump the version before packaging.\x1b[0m'); process.exit(1);} else {console.log('\x1b[32mVersion check passed: v'+mv+' is in sync and ready to package.\x1b[0m');}"
scripts.package: mkdir -p archives && rm -f archives/http-tracker-$(node -e "process.stdout.write(require('./manifest.json').version)").zip && zip -r archives/http-tracker-$(node -e "process.stdout.write(require('./manifest.json').version)").zip manifest.json src/ -x "*.DS_Store" -x "*__MACOSX*"
